Objective: Ensure every user has a unique account.
Disable access promptly on termination or transfer.
Recertify access to systems and data on a schedule.
Grant access based on business role and need.
Control guest, contractor, and vendor access.
Disable unused accounts after a defined period.
Prohibit shared accounts unless formally approved.
Manage identity changes through HR or IT workflow.
Govern identity sync between local and cloud directories.
Assign and review business owners for service accounts.
Log provisioning, changes, and removals for accountability.
